WITH signal_quality AS (
    SELECT
        o.weathprofile AS weather_condition,
        s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm) AS snqi
    FROM signals AS s
    INNER JOIN telescopes AS t
        ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    INNER JOIN observatories AS o
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
)
SELECT
    weather_condition,
    AVG(snqi) AS avg_snqi,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY snqi) AS median_snqi,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN snqi > 0 THEN 1 END) AS analyzable_signal_count
FROM signal_quality
GROUP BY weather_condition
ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;

WITH signal_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.signalregistry,
        p.anomscore,
        p.techsigprob * (1 - p.natsrcprob) * p.sigunique * (0.5 + p.anomscore / 10.0) AS tols,
        s.bwhz / NULLIF(s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000, 0) AS bfr
    FROM signals AS s
    INNER JOIN signalprobabilities AS p
        ON s.signalregistry = p.signalref
),
categorized_signals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN tols < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN tols < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS tols_category,
        bfr,
        anomscore
    FROM signal_metrics
)
SELECT
    tols_category,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(bfr) AS avg_bfr,
    STDDEV(anomscore) AS stddev_anomaly_score
FROM categorized_signals
GROUP BY tols_category
ORDER BY
    CASE tols_category
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;
